reason: The submitted CIF is a valid, fully ordered I4/mmm realization: it expands to Tb2Ga8Co16 (26 atoms, Z=2) with unit occupancies and reduces to a 13-atom primitive cell containing exactly Tb(GaCo2)4; its conventional cell is a=b=8.370536 A, c=4.940799 A. Indexing is strong (all first 20 lines indexed, M(20)=109), and direct re-audit found every one of the 41 observed peaks with prominence >1 matched within 0.035 degrees 2theta, with no calculated reflection above 1.5% relative intensity missing. Atomic-coordinate evidence is substantive: the instantiated model was whole-profile refined to Rwp about 3.56%, and GSAS-II gave wR=3.31% with the submitted positive displacement factors fixed versus a 2.24% profile lower bound; Ga and Co positional parameters converged near x(Ga-8i)=0.3437 and x(Co-8j)=0.2747. The discrete Ga/Co alternatives were explicitly instantiated and fit much worse under the same comparison (Rwp 17.75% for Ga-8f and 19.92% for Ga-8j, versus 9.19% for Ga-8i before subsequent profile/scattering refinements), with diagnostic weak reflections also favoring Ga-8i. Complete periodic neighbor shells show no overlaps or pervasive implausible contacts (minimum distance 2.439 A) and coherent intermetallic coordination. No important unexplained reflection, superstructure signal, occupancy issue, or concrete surviving incompatible realization is present; the absent separately supplied comparable score is therefore not decisive.
